== Biography ==
Robert Finley Glasgow was a son of [[Glasgow-589|Moses Thomas Glasgow]] and [[Pierce-14470|Mary J. Pierce]]. The family account places him with [[Glasgow-2357|Lois Ladd]] and an infant John Cameron in Moses and Mary’s child group. After Mary’s death in 1846, [[Thompson-63146|Martha Thompson]] became the children’s stepmother through her 1848 marriage to Moses.<ref name="GlasgowFamilyHistory">[https://www.wikitree.com/photo.php/0/0a/Glasgow-590.pdf History of the Glasgow Family], attributed to William Melanchthon Glasgow, undated typescript, p. 5.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-589]] is assessed at 97% (proved). The held Moses biography specifically names Robert Finley as a child of Moses and Mary Pierce. Robert's 1850 and 1860 entries in Moses's household support both the distinctive full name and chronology.

Selected Glasgow-589 fatherhood of Glasgow-2356; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare the original family history and early household images.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/photo/pdf/Glasgow-590 Family history document written by William Melanchthon Glasgow [https://www.wikitree.com/photo/pdf/Glasgow-590]]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.

=== Maternal review, 26 October 2026 ===

The original family-history page 5 records Moses and Mary Pierce married 5 November 1839, with three children: Lois Ladd, Robert Finley, and an infant John Cameron. It records Mary’s death on 14 March 1846 and Moses’s marriage to Martha Thompson in 1848. Page 6’s Robert career account matches this subject’s 1844–1912 life and excludes the namesake Robert born in 1820 and deceased in 1887.

Mary J. Pierce is assessed at **93% confident, qualified to the retrospective family-account scope** as Robert's biological mother. This does not claim contemporary birth proof. Martha Thompson is **strongly supported as Robert's stepmother**; no biological percentage is assigned to Martha. The prior live mother field remains Martha, unmarked. No father, vital, or live-profile field is changed.

The source is undated and attributed to William Melanchthon Glasgow. It contains known date errors; its wording that Mary was “in her twenty-sixth year” means age 25 and is compatible with the retained birth before 1821. This does not change any vital field, and is not an original birth or death certificate.
